department: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: Help for SC and ST people to start or grow a business. The government pays 35% of the project cost as a subsidy, up to Rs 1.5 crore. You also get 6% interest help on machinery loans for up to 10 years.

other: You must live in Tamil Nadu.
The business must be 100% owned by SC/ST people.
It can be a new business or a bigger version of an old one.
Manufacturing, service, and larger trading projects can apply.

how_to_apply: Apply online on the MSME Department website. Click 'Apply Online' and then 'New Application'. Register, log in, fill the form and upload your papers.

evidence.quote: launched by the Department of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Government of Tamil Nadu
35% capital subsidy ( Not exceeding Rs 1.5 crore) on eligible project cost
6% interest subvention for loans to procure machinery and equipment during the tenure of loan not exceeding 10 years
Beneficiaries belonging to SC/ST communities (100% owned by SC/ST persons)
Beneficiaries shall be with age limit of 55 years
The applicant should be a resident of the State of Tamil Nadu.
Covering new and expansion of existing enterprises
The eligible enterprises can be business enterprises in the areas of manufacturing and services.
Identity proof i.e. copy of Election ID Card/ Aadhaar card
On the home page, click on “Apply Online” and then “New Application”.
Upload all the necessary documents and submit the application form.
